description: We’re Biolumina, a team of six from Muscat, Oman. Our name comes from bioluminescence, the light living things create to shine in the dark. In space, astronauts lose muscle strength fast. We’re building a smart grip trainer: a sensor measures grip force in real time and sends it to a computer game, turning daily exercise into play. It tracks each astronaut’s strength, adapts as they improve, and flags drops early so they can act. Our mission: keep every astronaut strong.
